named_mechanism: Bayesian black-hole-superradiance constraint framework using full posterior samples
definition: Ingest posterior samples in black-hole mass and dimensionless spin
Map each sample and trial boson mass to a probabilistic superradiance consistency score
Aggregate over posterior samples to obtain a source-level exclusion probability
Combine independent sources in a joint Bayesian constraint
Report credible upper limits directly on boson mass and on an effective self-interaction coupling proxy
assumptions: Weak self-interaction regime for baseline boson-mass exclusion
Approximate phenomenological Regge boundary rather than full Teukolsky-rate calculation
Independence between black-hole posterior samples and between sources conditional on model
invariants: Use full posterior sample clouds, not only means or MAP estimates
Produce direct exclusion/credible-limit artifacts in the named target quantities
